{{Quote|Ah, youth...|Donners}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC professor who can be found during the day, looking over the Academy's Garden. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:;(Nearby Idle)
:;The Dorm Guarding Fanclub, the School Support Staff Society, the Royan Folk Dance Revival Club... 
:;How is Denia on the attendance roster for literally every single one? 

:;Professor, I'd like to file a complaint against that last club… we Roya never dance like that.

:'''Donners''' Ah, youth...

== Dialogue ==
:'''Donners:''' Are you a new student? I don't think I've seen you around before.
:{{DIcon}} Yep.
:{{DIcon}} How did you know...?
::'''Donners:''' Haha, I've been teaching here for a long time. I remember every face that comes through these halls.
:'''Donners:''' New students are always full of curiosity. Some chat up anyone who'll listen, trying try to map the place out.
:'''Donners:''' Then a couple of years pass, and they're buried in academic problems with hardly any free time.
:'''Donners:''' But when they're about to graduate, those kids...
:'''Donners:''' They're just as lost as when they first arrived, but the look in their eyes and the way they carry themselves are completely transformed.
:'''Donners:''' Maybe that kind of change marks the passing of something. Maybe it's "youth"... Ha...
:'''Donners:''' 
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:'''Donners:''' Ah, if it isn't our rising star. Thank you for your bravery out there.
:{{DIcon}} How did you know...?
:'''Donners:''' Haha, curiosity isn't the exclusive remit of students. A seasoned professor like me keeps an eye on the news.
:'''Donners:''' The whole campus is talking about you. "Dark Thunderbolt," "Voidworm Rider"... You're a fine example for everyone.
:'''Donners:''' Even the freshmen seemed less lost. Of course, you can still see the exhaustion in their eyes, but there's more determination now, too.
:'''Donners:''' Everyone in Startorch Academy knows that a Void Storm may strike at any time, and that one day we'll have to face the enemy beyond the Stridergate.
:'''Donners:''' Still, most people panic when everything comes crashing down. And when a torchbearer appears to lead the charge, they earn our admiration and trust.
:'''Donners:''' In time, others will follow, stepping onto the front lines themselves. That journey, that transformation, maybe that's what "youth" is really about.
{{Dialogue End}}
